command: if [ -f inventory/transfer.go ]; then exec go test -count=1 ./...; else exec go test -count=1 -json ./...; fi

control: The baseline is measured with this overlaid command: the base tree has no inventory/transfer.go, so there it runs go test -json and the baseline is green. On the builder's candidate, which adds transfer.go, it prints go test's text (an ok line), which a reader that guessed from text would take as a pass; with -json the same tree is the candidate case's clean gate.
